verdict.rationale: The only first-party hint is svelte-docs-26, which addresses Svelte 4 users and lists which syntax changed versus stayed the same. That implies version-transition documentation, but nothing shows it is a dedicated, step-by-step migration guide. Community comments confirm breaking changes happened but say nothing about migration docs. Missing for 10: an explicitly named dedicated migration guide (e.g., Svelte 4→5 or SvelteKit major upgrades), documented migration steps or tooling, and independent corroboration that developers successfully used it.
